title: Settling within 10 minutes after a drop-off
summary: Most children calm within 10 minutes after you leave, such as at childcare, by about 3 years, CDC says.
body: Ten minutes is the figure printed on the CDC 3-year line, and the example is a childcare drop-off. The line is about recovery after a parting, not about whether the child cried at the door. A longer upset is not named as an illness. Most, for this publisher, is 75 percent or more, and the sheet does not replace screening.

sources.title: Milestones by 3 Years
